title: Flutter: game chrome — score, clock, turn indicator, phase display
description: Scaffold widgets for game metadata: BaizeScore (player scores/counters), BaizeClock (time controls countdown), BaizeTurnIndicator (whose turn, phase name), BaizeHistory (scrollable event log). Material Design 3 theming. Dark/light mode. Responsive layout: phone portrait, tablet landscape, desktop widescreen.
